# SKILL — PHOTO EXAMINATION

## Purpose
Extract useful physical evidence from photographs before researching maker or value.

## Examine in this order
1. Whole-object silhouette and proportions
2. Colour and clarity
3. Rim
4. Base
5. Pontil / polished base
6. Mould seams
7. Tooling and applied work
8. Handles and joins
9. Cut or engraved decoration
10. Bubbles, striae and inclusions
11. Labels
12. Signatures / etched / engraved / moulded marks
13. Wear
14. Chips, cracks, repairs and grinding
15. Weight and dimensions if supplied

## Evidence cautions
These can be useful clues but are not proof of age or maker by themselves: bubbles, rough pontil, heaviness, rainbow refraction, sharp cuts, wear, family story.

## Ask for extra images only when they materially improve the answer
High-value requests: square-on base photo; close-up of any mark; rim at side angle; pontil in raking light; damage close-up; label close-up; object beside ruler; UV photo only if relevant to a specific question.
